name: Training Lab - EVPN/VXLAN CRB
description: Juniper EX EVPN-VXLAN fabric, centrally-routed bridging: the spines are the gateways, OSPF underlay with an iBGP overlay (spines are route reflectors), VRFs PROD/DEV/DMZ, an L2-only vMotion VLAN, 4 access switches on ESI-LAGs. 10 projects and a network map in Lab and in Production. Switch root and labadmin password: Sample-Lab-Root1.

system.banner: EVPN-VXLAN CRB data center fabric lab. Gateways live on the spines. Lab use only.
